title: Default screenshot capture output to the task docs folder
goal:
# Default screenshot capture output to the task docs folder

## Problem
The repo's screenshot tool (`scripts/capture-screenshot.mjs`) writes PNG bytes directly, which is the binary-safe way for agents to attach proof screenshots. But its `--out` flag defaults to `screenshot.png` in the repo root (code: `getArg("--out") || "screenshot.png"`). Every agent must therefore remember to pass an explicit `--out docs/tasks/<task-id>/<name>-proof.png` on every capture. If an agent forgets or improvises, the PNG lands at the repo root, trips the repo-root scratch-hygiene gate, and costs a full verification cycle to diagnose and move — the same class of wasted cycle the proof-hygiene work was created to eliminate. The safe recipe in `docs/tasks/_PROOF_RULE.md` works only when the one easy-to-forget flag is present.

## Fix
Make the capture script default to a task-folder-aware output path so the no-flag invocation is already correct: when `--out` is omitted, resolve the current task id (in order: an explicit env var such as `TASK_ID`/`KAINBAIN_TASK_ID` if the runner sets one, else the `kb/<task-id>` git branch name, else fail with a message naming the expected `--out` form) and write to `docs/tasks/<task-id>/screenshot-<timestamp>.png`, creating the directory as today. Keep an explicit `--out` as an override that always wins. Update the header usage comment, the `_PROOF_RULE.md` recipe, and `docs/agent-docs/GitGuidance.md` if they show the default. Add unit tests mirroring the existing `tests/capture-screenshot.test.mjs` style: default resolves into the task folder when the id is discoverable; explicit `--out` wins; no discoverable id fails fast naming `--out`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Running the capture script without `--out` on a task branch writes a valid PNG (magic `89504e47`) under `docs/tasks/<task-id>/`, never repo root.
- [ ] An explicit `--out` still overrides the default exactly as today.
- [ ] With no discoverable task id, the script exits non-zero with a message showing the `--out` form.
- [ ] `npm run check:proof-hygiene`, `npm run check:binaries`, and the existing capture/guard test suites stay green.

## Non-goals
No change to the PNG byte-writing mechanism, the binary guard, or the proof-hygiene detector semantics; no new runtime dependencies.

## Case study
Follow-on from KainBain task ef569a1a-d301-4e10-aaba-8cde942b97e8 ("Prevent binary proof PNG corruption instead of only detecting it"): its deep review (`docs/tasks/ef569a1a-d301-4e10-aaba-8cde942b97e8/review-pr-20261116.md`, section 4, nit 2) notes the root default is still open and "a task-folder-aware default would close the loop". See also the prevention rule (`docs/tasks/_PROOF_RULE.md`) and prior detection ticket b1c069e0 for context.

reports.content:
# Implementation Plan — Default screenshot capture output to the task docs folder

## Goal

Make the no-flag invocation of `scripts/capture-screenshot.mjs` already correct: without `--out`, the script resolves the current task id and writes to `docs/tasks/<task-id>/screenshot-<timestamp>.png` (creating the directory), instead of defaulting to `screenshot.png` at the repo root. An explicit `--out` always wins as an override. This closes the loop left open by task `ef569a1a-d301-4e10-aaba-8cde942b97e8` (deep review `docs/tasks/ef569a1a-d301-4e10-aaba-8cde942b97e8/review-pr-20261116.md`, section 4, nit 2: "a task-folder-aware default would close the loop") while leaving the PNG byte-writing mechanism, the binary guard, and the proof-hygiene detector semantics untouched.

## Success criteria (maps to acceptance criteria)

1. No-flag capture on a task branch writes a valid PNG (magic `89504e47`) under `docs/tasks/<task-id>/`, never repo root.
2. Explicit `--out` overrides the default exactly as today.
3. No discoverable task id → exit non-zero with a message showing the `--out` form.
4. `npm run check:proof-hygiene`, `npm run check:binaries`, and the existing capture/guard test suites stay green.

## Context and evidence (researched this session)

- Current default (root cause): `scripts/capture-screenshot.mjs:74` — `const outputPath = getArg("--out") || "screenshot.png";` resolved against `process.cwd()` at line 97–98 (`path.resolve` + `mkdirSync recursive`). Forgetting `--out` therefore lands a PNG at the repo root, which trips the root scratch-hygiene gate in `scripts/check-proof-and-hygiene.mjs`.
- Safe recipe that works only with the easy-to-forget flag: `docs/tasks/_PROOF_RULE.md:15` — `node scripts/capture-screenshot.mjs --path "#/tasks/<task-id>" --out docs/tasks/<task-id>/<name>-proof.png`.
- Agent rule pointing at the recipe: `docs/agent-docs/GitGuidance.md` ("Binary-safe proof artifacts" section, lines 32–37) — shows `--out <path>` form and defers to `_PROOF_RULE.md`.
- Existing test style to mirror: `tests/capture-screenshot.test.mjs` — `node:test` + `assert/strict`, temp fixture trees via `makeFixtureTree`, currently covers only the exported `verifyPngMagic`, not arg/output resolution.
- Env-var search this session: no existing `TASK_ID` / `KAINBAIN_TASK_ID` consumer found under `scripts/` or `docs/agent-docs/` — the plan must define the precedence explicitly (env first, branch second) since there is no established helper to reuse. Confirm the runner's actual variable name during implementation; support both names.
- Branch convention: `docs/agent-docs/GitGuidance.md:9` — task branches have form `kb/<task-id>`.
- Grill survey (`docs/tasks/b3ab7335-f277-4aa7-b265-ad421e09ad1a/SURVEY.md`, round 1, all Recommended options selected) binds three decisions: (Q1) default into the current task folder; (Q2) fail fast with a short `--out` message when no task is discoverable — never silently fall back to root or a temp folder; (Q3) timestamped unique filename per capture so nothing is overwritten.

## Key decisions

1. **Default path shape:** `docs/tasks/<task-id>/screenshot-<timestamp>.png` (timestamp e.g. `YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS`, local time; survey Q3). Directory created with the existing `mkdirSync recursive` behavior (Fix statement: "creating the directory as today").
2. **Task-id resolution order (Fix statement):** (a) explicit env var `TASK_ID`, else `KAINBAIN_TASK_ID`, if set and non-empty; (b) else current git branch name matching `kb/<task-id>` (take the segment after `kb/`, validate non-empty, no path separators); (c) else fail fast, exit non-zero, message naming the expected `--out` form (survey Q2). Never fall back to `screenshot.png`, repo root, or a shared temp folder.
3. **Override semantics:** explicit `--out` wins byte-for-byte exactly as today (relative paths still resolve against `process.cwd()`); default logic runs only when `--out` is absent (acceptance criterion 2).
4. **"Make change easy, then make the change":** first extract a small pure, exported, unit-testable resolver (e.g. `resolveDefaultOut({ argv, env, branch })` or equivalent) with zero new runtime dependencies (stdlib `node:child_process` for `git branch --show-current`, or read first; non-goal: no new runtime deps), keeping `main()` behavior identical; then wire it into `main()` and update docs/tests. This keeps the risky branch/env parsing testable without launching Playwright.
5. **No behavior changes beyond the default:** PNG byte writing, `verifyPngMagic` self-check, `check-binary-guard` (`BINARY_MAGIC`), and proof-hygiene detector semantics are untouched (Non-goals).

## Work plan (ordered; big/research pieces first)

### Phase 0 — Research spikes (do first, before editing)

- **Step 0.1 — Confirm task-id sources.** Check what the runner actually sets: inspect a live task worktree env / runner docs for `TASK_ID` vs `KAINBAIN_TASK_ID`; confirm `git branch --show-current` returns `kb/<task-id>` inside engine-created `kb-*` worktrees and what it returns on detached HEAD / main (resolver must treat those as "no id"). Record the exact variable name(s) supported — code supports both, docs name the one the runner sets.
- **Step 0.2 — Confirm doc touchpoints.** Re-read `docs/tasks/_PROOF_RULE.md`, `docs/agent-docs/GitGuidance.md`, and the header usage comment in `scripts/capture-screenshot.mjs:7-9`; list every line showing the old default or a mandatory `--out`. Check for any other docs/scripts referencing `screenshot.png` at root (`muse.search` for `screenshot.png` and `capture-screenshot`) so the doc update is complete but scoped.

### Phase 1 — Make the change easy (pure refactor, no behavior change)

- **Step 1.1 — Extract output-path resolution into an exported pure function.** Move lines 74/97–98 logic into e.g. `export function resolveOutputPath({ outArg, env, getBranch })` (exact name per codebase parallel; check sibling script export style first). Initial behavior identical: `outArg ?? "screenshot.png"`. Export it alongside `verifyPngMagic` so `tests/capture-screenshot.test.mjs` can import it with no Playwright launch. Verify: existing test file still passes unchanged.
- **Step 1.2 — Add the task-id helpers as pure functions.** Add `resolveTaskId({ env, branch })` implementing the precedence (env `TASK_ID` → `KAINBAIN_TASK_ID` → `kb/<task-id>` branch parse → null) plus `defaultTaskScreenshotPath(taskId, now)` producing `docs/tasks/<task-id>/screenshot-<timestamp>.png`. Keep them branch/env-injected (parameters, not direct `process.env` reads inside) so tests inject values. Sanitize: reject empty ids and ids containing `/`, `\`, `..`, or whitespace; return null (→ fail-fast path) rather than building a traversal path.

### Phase 2 — Make the change (behavior)

- **Step 2.1 — Wire the default into `main()`.** Replace `getArg("--out") || "screenshot.png"` with: if `--out` present, use it exactly as today; else `resolveTaskId(...)` → build default path → `mkdirSync recursive` as today; if unresolvable, `console.error` a message showing the `--out` form (e.g. `Cannot determine task id (checked $TASK_ID/$KAINBAIN_TASK_ID and kb/<task-id> branch). Pass --out explicitly, e.g. --out docs/tasks/<task-id>/<name>-proof.png`) and `process.exit(1)` (or throw, matching the file's existing failure style) before launching the browser. Git branch lookup failure (not a repo, git missing) counts as "no id", not a crash with a raw stack.
- **Step 2.2 — Update the header usage comment** (`scripts/capture-screenshot.mjs:7-9`): document the new no-flag default, the resolution order, and that explicit `--out` overrides. Keep the proof-checklist lines (magic `xxd`/`file`, `check:binaries`) verbatim.
- **Step 2.3 — Update `docs/tasks/_PROOF_RULE.md` recipe**: show the no-flag invocation as the primary copy-paste (`node scripts/capture-screenshot.mjs --path "#/tasks/<task-id>"` → writes into the task folder) with explicit `--out docs/tasks/<task-id>/<name>-proof.png` documented as the override / custom-name form. Keep verify + gate steps unchanged.
- **Step 2.4 — Update `docs/agent-docs/GitGuidance.md` only if it shows the default**: the "Binary-safe proof artifacts" bullet currently shows `--out <path>` as an example path, which remains valid as the override; adjust wording only to note the new default (no-flag → task folder) and keep the pointer to `_PROOF_RULE.md` canonical. Do not restructure the file.

### Phase 3 — Tests (mirror existing style, in `tests/capture-screenshot.test.mjs` or its runner's adjacent file)

- **Step 3.1 — Default resolves into the task folder when the id is discoverable.** Cases: env `TASK_ID` wins; `KAINBAIN_TASK_ID` used when `TASK_ID` unset; `kb/<task-id>` branch used when neither env is set; output matches `docs/tasks/<task-id>/screenshot-<timestamp>.png` and never equals repo-root `screenshot.png`. Inject env/branch (no real git, no browser).
- **Step 3.2 — Explicit `--out` wins.** With a discoverable id AND `--out docs/tasks/<task-id>/custom-proof.png`, resolver/main returns the explicit path exactly (relative resolution unchanged).
- **Step 3.3 — No discoverable id fails fast naming `--out`.** No env, branch `main` / detached / git-unavailable → non-zero exit (or thrown error, per Step 2.1's mechanism) with message containing `--out` and the `docs/tasks/<task-id>/` form. Assert it does NOT return a root fallback.
- **Step 3.4 — Sanitization edge.** Malicious/odd ids (`../x`, `a/b`, empty) are rejected to the fail-fast path.

### Phase 4 — Verification and handoff

- **Step 4.1 — Run the gates the acceptance criteria name:** the capture test file (via whatever invokes `tests/capture-screenshot.test.mjs` — check `scripts/run-tests.mjs` for the node:test wiring), plus `npm run check:proof-hygiene` and `npm run check:binaries`. All green.
- **Step 4.2 — Live no-flag rehearsal (optional, cheap):** on the task branch with a stubbed target (or against the normal `KAINBAIN_URL` fixture), run without `--out`, then `xxd -l 8` + `file` on the produced PNG and confirm it sits under `docs/tasks/<task-id>/` and no `screenshot.png` appears at root; delete or keep the rehearsal PNG per task convention (proof files under the task folder are legitimate; root files are not).
- **Step 4.3 — Confirm non-goals held:** `git status` / diff shows changes only in `scripts/capture-screenshot.mjs`, `tests/capture-screenshot.test.mjs` (or adjacent), `_PROOF_RULE.md`, `GitGuidance.md`, and task docs; no new entries in `package.json` dependencies.

## Documentation plan

- Update in the same change as the code (Steps 2.2–2.4), not as a follow-up: header comment, `_PROOF_RULE.md` recipe (primary no-flag form + `--out` override form), `GitGuidance.md` wording only if it shows the default.
- This plan file (`docs/tasks/b3ab7335-f277-4aa7-b265-ad421e09ad1a/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md`) plus the survey (`SURVEY.md`) are the audit trail linking each decision to its source (survey Q1→default, Q2→fail-fast, Q3→timestamp name; nit 2 of the ef569a1a review → the whole task).

## Risks and mitigations

- **Runner env name differs** (`TASK_ID` vs `KAINBAIN_TASK_ID` vs unset): mitigate by supporting both names with documented precedence and verifying in Step 0.1; branch fallback covers runners that set neither.
- **Detached HEAD / non-`kb/` branch in CI or local main checkouts**: defined as "no id" → clear fail-fast message, never a root write (survey Q2). Message must be actionable (shows `--out` form), not a bare usage dump.
- **Timestamp collisions or timezone confusion**: timestamps are uniqueness aids, not ordering guarantees; format `YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS` (optionally plus short random suffix if the implementer wants collision-proofing within one second — keep stdlib-only).
- **Over-editing docs**: `GitGuidance.md` is owned guidance — change only the lines that show the default; `_PROOF_RULE.md` stays canonical.

## Non-goals (explicitly out of scope)

- No change to the PNG byte-writing mechanism, `verifyPngMagic` semantics, the binary guard (`scripts/check-binary-guard.mjs`, `BINARY_MAGIC`), or the proof-hygiene detector semantics.
- No new runtime dependencies (Node stdlib only).
- No migration of existing screenshots; no allowlist/baseline edits unless a rehearsal artifact requires cleanup (then remove the artifact, not the rule).

reports.content:
# PR review — Default screenshot capture output to the task docs folder

Task: b3ab7335-f277-4aa7-b265-ad421e09ad1a. Scope (`git diff main...HEAD --name-only`): `scripts/capture-screenshot.mjs`, `tests/capture-screenshot.test.mjs`, `docs/tasks/_PROOF_RULE.md`, `docs/agent-docs/GitGuidance.md`, plus this task's plan/survey/approval docs. No `package.json`, guard, detector, or gate-wiring changes. Reviewed 2026-11-17; verdict at the end of the stage message.

## 1. Goal achievement (acceptance criteria, each probed — nothing taken on trust)

- AC1 — no-flag capture on a task branch lands under `docs/tasks/<task-id>/`, never root. PASS. Real branch here is `kb/b3ab7335-f277-4aa7-b265-ad421e09ad1a`; resolving through the real `git branch --show-current` output gives `docs/tasks/b3ab7335-f277-4aa7-b265-ad421e09ad1a/screenshot-20261116-183005.png` (fixed clock), and unit tests pin `notEqual(result, "screenshot.png")` plus a `docs/tasks/` prefix. A no-flag entrypoint probe (`env -u TASK_ID -u KAINBAIN_TASK_ID node scripts/capture-screenshot.mjs --url about:blank`) sailed past output resolution to the Playwright import stage and left `git status` clean — no fail-fast error, no root write. Full browser launch to a magic-`89504e47` PNG was impossible here (no `playwright`/`@playwright/test` npm package installed, browsers only) — the same documented environment limitation the ef569a1a review accepted, and the byte-writing mechanism (`page.screenshot({ path })` + `verifyPngMagic`) is byte-identical in behavior.
- AC2 — explicit `--out` overrides exactly as today. PASS. Four unit tests: wins with a discoverable id, wins with no id, returns the string byte-for-byte, and `main()` applies the `-01` dedup suffix to default paths only so explicit `--out` keeps exact overwrite behavior.
- AC3 — no discoverable id fails fast naming `--out`. PASS. Unit test on `resolveOutputPath` plus a real-entrypoint spawn test; I re-ran it manually in an empty `/tmp` dir with env scrubbed and `GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES` set: exit 1, stderr `Cannot determine task id (checked $TASK_ID/$KAINBAIN_TASK_ID and the kb/<task-id> branch). Pass --out explicitly, e.g. --out docs/tasks/<task-id>/<name>-proof.png`, directory left empty.
- AC4 — gates green. PASS. `npm run check:proof-hygiene` ✓ (11 baselined pre-existing issues only), `npm run check:binaries` ✓, capture/guard/hygiene/run-tests/hook suites 215/215 ✓ (`node --test` on the six files), plus `check:jsdoc-example` ✓ and `check:one-function` ✓ for the new JSDoc blocks.

## 2. Plan compliance

Followed `IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md` phase by phase: pure exported resolver first (`resolveOutputPath`/`resolveTaskId`/`sanitizeTaskId`/`buildDefaultTaskScreenshotPath`/`findUnusedFilePath`/`readFlagValue`, all env/branch/clock-injected, stdlib-only), then `main()` wiring that fails before any browser launch, then the three doc touchpoints, then tests in the existing file mirroring `node:test` + `assert/strict` + `makeFixtureTree` style. Survey bindings honored (Q1 task-folder default, Q2 fail-fast never root/temp, Q3 timestamped unique names). Three small implementer choices beyond the letter of the plan, all documented in JSDoc, tested, and goal-serving: (a) flag-follows-flag reads as missing, closing a `--out --path` writes-file-named-`--path`-at-root hole; (b) deterministic `-01..-99` same-second dedup instead of the optional random suffix; (c) a non-empty but unsafe env id is terminal fail-fast rather than falling through to another source. Non-goals held: no new runtime deps, guard/detector semantics untouched, no baseline/allowlist edits.

## 3. Standards, maintainability, best practices, tech debt

Standards PASS: `MARK:`/`@description`/`@example` JSDoc matches file and repo conventions; both static gates pass. Maintainability PASS: small pure functions with injected seams, each with focused tests; no Playwright/git/disk in unit tests. Best practices PASS: allowlist sanitizer (`^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$`) rejects traversal, separators, hidden names, whitespace; git failure yields null, never a raw stack; error messages always show the `--out` form. Tech debt: none added — tests stayed in the already gate-registered file so `run-tests.mjs` needed no change, and the `verifyPngMagic` diff is variable renames only.

## 4. Docs completeness

All required docs updated with minimal, correct diffs: header usage comment (no-flag default, resolution order, override-wins, `-01` dedup, flag-token rule, fail-fast cases), `_PROOF_RULE.md` (no-flag primary recipe, `--out` custom-name form, timestamped verify paths), `GitGuidance.md` (two-line wording change, canonical pointer kept). Repo-wide search for remaining `screenshot.png` / `capture-screenshot` references: the only live-code hit is an explicit-`--out` example into a task folder (still valid as the override form); the binary-guard remedy and pre-commit comment use explicit `--out <path>` (still valid); other hits are historical task docs correctly left alone.

## 5. Live-ops interference

None. Verification used `/tmp` probes, fixture temp dirs, and read-only gates; the working tree is untouched outside this review file (confirmed via `git status` after the entrypoint probes).

## 6. Conclusion

Goal achieved on all four criteria with independent probing, plan followed, standards pass, docs updated in all required places, no new tech debt. Safe to integrate.

1|# Proof PNG rule (read before attaching screenshots)
2|
3|**Never create, edit, or restore `*.png` — or any listed binary
4|(`*.jpg`, `*.jpeg`, `*.gif`, `*.webp`, `*.zip`, `*.gz`, `*.tgz`) — with
5|text edit/write tools.** A text-mode round-trip replaces high bytes with
6|U+FFFD (`ef bf bd`), silently corrupting the image while the filename
7|still looks right (`file` then reports `data` instead of `PNG image
8|data`). This exact corruption failed full CI twice on one ticket; the
9|rule below is how you stay on the binary-safe path.
10|
11|## Safe recipe (copy-paste; no improvisation)
12|
13|```sh
14|# 1. Capture — the script writes PNG bytes directly (agents only reference the path).
15|#    No --out needed: it defaults into the current task folder as screenshot-<timestamp>.png:
16|node scripts/capture-screenshot.mjs --path "#/tasks/<task-id>"
17|#    (Custom name instead of the timestamped default:)
18|#    node scripts/capture-screenshot.mjs --path "#/tasks/<task-id>" --out docs/tasks/<task-id>/<name>-proof.png
19|
20|# 2. Verify the worktree bytes before claiming validity (use the path the capture printed):
21|xxd -l 8 docs/tasks/<task-id>/screenshot-<timestamp>.png   # expect 8950 4e47…
22|file docs/tasks/<task-id>/screenshot-<timestamp>.png       # expect PNG image data
23|
24|# 3. Pre-handoff gate (seconds; fails fast naming the file):
25|npm run check:binaries
26|```
27|
28|Then reference the path in reports — never copy bytes through chat,
29|editors, or "restore" snippets. The capture script self-verifies PNG
30|magic after writing; quote its `PNG magic verified` line plus the `xxd`
31|/ `file` outputs next to any validity claim.
32|
33|## If a proof is already corrupt
34|
35|Do not hand-edit it. Either re-capture with the command above, or
36|restore a known-good copy binary-safely:
37|
38|```sh
39|git checkout <good-ref> -- docs/tasks/<task-id>/<name>-proof.png
40|xxd -l 8 docs/tasks/<task-id>/<name>-proof.png
41|file docs/tasks/<task-id>/<name>-proof.png
42|npm run check:binaries
43|```
44|
45|## Enforcement layers
46|
47|- `npm run check:binaries` — fail-fast local guard over changed
48|  binaries (run before every handoff; seconds, names the file with
49|  expected vs actual magic and this remedy). Also runs automatically in
50|  `npm test` as the `Binary Guard` branch, so a corrupt binary fails the
51|  verification gate even without the hook.
52|- Pre-commit hook (`scripts/githooks/pre-commit`) — same guard over
53|  staged binaries at commit time; fails closed (if it cannot run, the
54|  commit is refused). Installed automatically by `npm run setup`, or
55|  manually with `npm run hooks:install` (sets `core.hooksPath` to
56|  `scripts/githooks`; linked worktrees — including engine-created `kb-*`
57|  task worktrees — inherit it via the shared repo config). Bypass with
58|  `git commit --no-verify` only for an intentional baseline entry.
59|- `npm run check:proof-hygiene` — tree-wide CI gate re-verifying every
60|  proof image (detection stays as the backstop).
61|
62|Canonical agent rule: `docs/agent-docs/GitGuidance.md`
63|("Binary-safe proof artifacts"). Guarded extensions are data in
64|`scripts/check-binary-guard.mjs` (`BINARY_MAGIC`); `.gitattributes`
65|marks them `binary` so git never normalizes them.

1|# Git Guidance for Agents
2|
3|> **Status:** initial version created for AUDIT R2 (forward pointer from
4|> `agents.md`). Owned by R10 — R10 may expand or replace this file without
5|> touching `agents.md`.
6|
7|## Branch discipline
8|
9|- Stay on the current task branch (form `kb/<task-id>`). Do your work there.
10|- The engine owns the branch lifecycle: it creates the task branch, commits,
11|  pushes, and merges into the main branch after the stage passes.
12|- Do NOT checkout, merge, rebase, push, or delete branches — the pipeline's
13|  merge stage integrates your work.
14|
15|## Commit hygiene
16|
17|- Keep the working tree clean: only the files your stage owns should change.
18|- Never commit, amend, push, tag, rebase, cherry-pick, revert, or
19|  `reset --hard` unless the user asked for that exact write in this session.
20|- After installer/generator commands, check `git status` and revert collateral
21|  edits you did not intend (e.g. lockfile rewrites).
22|- Never touch the `docs/` symlink target (out-of-repo notes store, not versioned).
23|
24|## Binary-safe proof artifacts
25|
26|- Binary files (PNG screenshots, JPEG/GIF/WebP captures, `.tgz` bundles) must
27|  be written through a binary-safe path only — never through text edit tools.
28|  A text-mode read/write round-trip replaces high bytes with U+FFFD
29|  (`ef bf bd`), silently corrupting the image while the filename still looks
30|  right (this shipped a corrupted `pretty-proof.png` that `file` reported as
31|  `data` on task 5a38ad45).
32|- Safe paths: screenshot capture scripts that write bytes directly (e.g.
33|  `node scripts/capture-screenshot.mjs`, which defaults into the current
34|  task folder — `--out <path>` overrides when a custom name is needed),
35|  or restoring a known good copy with `git checkout <ref> -- <path>`.
36|  Never open a binary in an
37|  editor or rewrite it with a text-oriented tool. The copy-pasteable safe
38|  recipe lives at `docs/tasks/_PROOF_RULE.md` — follow it exactly, no
39|  improvisation.
40|- Before claiming a proof file is valid, verify the worktree bytes:
41|  `xxd -l 8 <path>` (expect `8950 4e47 0d0a 1a0a` for PNG) and
42|  `file <path>` (expect `PNG image data, ...`, not `data`). Quote both
43|  outputs in the stage report next to the claim. The capture script also

import json, hashlib, urllib.request

PID="0fd41821-d8a5-4e49-bc2e-28ce8c739a0a"
CUR="b3ab7335-f277-4aa7-b265-ad421e09ad1a"
key = hashlib.sha256(f"unified-runner-stage-env-contract|1|{CUR}".encode()).hexdigest()[:32]
print("KEY:", key)
body = {
  "projectId": PID,
  "title": "Unify runner stage env contract: inject task identity into agent stages and document it",
  "goal": ("Scripts running inside agent stages cannot reliably discover the current task id or task docs folder from the "
    "environment, while CI and command stages can — so every script re-derives identity from git branch names and every agent "
    "re-researches the env contract from source. Today the contract is fragmented: CI children receive KAINBAIN_TASK_ID + "
    "KAINBAIN_TASK_DOCS (runner/daemon.js runCiCommand call site); command stages receive the full KAINBAIN_* set "
    "(api/flow/commandStages.js buildCommandStageEnv); agent harnesses receive TASK_ID at best and inconsistently (shared helper "
    "api/agent/harnesses/shared/harnessScaffold.js withRunContextVars, used by the custom harness; codex sets TASK_ID directly); "
    "and the muse harness child env (api/agent/harnesses/muse/musePermissions.js buildMuseChildEnv) allowlists only "
    "PATH/HOME/LANG/TZ/SHELL/TMPDIR/proxies plus MUSE_*/XDG_* — no task vars at all, confirmed by a live agent-stage shell showing "
    "zero TASK_*/KAINBAIN_* vars. No canonical doc lists the per-stage-type contract (runner/README.md documents only runner-config vars). "
    "Work: (1) extend the shared harness scaffold so every agent-harness child env pins KAINBAIN_TASK_ID and KAINBAIN_TASK_DOCS "
    "alongside TASK_ID (one helper, all harnesses incl. muse/pi/codex/opencode/custom); (2) document the canonical contract — which "
    "vars each stage type (agent/CI/command) guarantees — in one place agents actually read (runner/README.md plus a pointer from "
    "docs/agent-docs/); (3) simplify scripts/capture-screenshot.mjs resolution to prefer KAINBAIN_TASK_DOCS (absolute path, no branch "
    "parsing) keeping existing fallbacks; (4) add unit tests mirroring tests/capture-screenshot.test.mjs style plus a harness contract "
    "test asserting the vars are present. Acceptance: a script in any agent stage resolves task id + task docs dir from env alone; docs "
    "name the contract; capture/guard/harness suites stay green; no new runtime deps. "
    "Case study: KainBain task b3ab7335-f277-4aa7-b265-ad421e09ad1a ('Default screenshot capture output to the task docs folder') — its "
    "docs/tasks/b3ab7335-f277-4aa7-b265-ad421e09ad1a/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md context section ('no existing TASK_ID/KAINBAIN_TASK_ID "
    "consumer found under scripts/ or docs/agent-docs/') plus its Phase 0 Step 0.1 research spike ('inspect a live task worktree env / "
    "runner docs') show the wasted cycle: the vars existed in runner/ and api/ but were undiscoverable from the scoped search, so the "
    "script re-derives docs/tasks/<id> via kb/<task-id> branch parsing (fragile on detached HEAD / non-kb branches) instead of using the "
    "absolute KAINBAIN_TASK_DOCS var CI stages already receive (precedent consumer: scripts/lib/fast-gate-verdict.mjs taskDocsDirOf). "
    "See also that task's review-pr-20261117.md and precursor task ef569a1a-d301-4e10-aaba-8cde942b97e8."),
  "stageId": "1",
  "workflowId": "wf-default",
  "idempotencyKey": key,
  "execute": False,
}
req = urllib.request.Request(BASE+"/tasks", data=json.dumps(body).encode(), headers={"Content-Type":"application/json"}, method="POST")
with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=20) as r:
    print("STATUS:", r.status)
    print(json.dumps(json.load(r), indent=1)[:2000])
EOF","description":"Create unified stage-env ticket"}

  detection ticket `b1c069e0-1875-4aa7-b51d-4c4399b2be31`, both completed.

## Difficulties found (agent-effort costs)

1. **Undiscoverable runner env contract (structural — ticketed).**
   The plan's research (`IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md:20`) scoped its env search to `scripts/` and
   `docs/agent-docs/`, found "no existing `TASK_ID`/`KAINBAIN_TASK_ID` consumer", and burned a
   Phase 0 spike (Step 0.1: "inspect a live task worktree env / runner docs") to confirm the
   runner's variable name. In reality the runner DOES set these — but fragmented by stage type
   and documented nowhere:
   - CI stages: `KAINBAIN_TASK_ID` + `KAINBAIN_TASK_DOCS` (`runner/daemon.js:1908`).
   - Command stages: full `KAINBAIN_*` set (`api/flow/commandStages.js:522-523`).
   - Agent harnesses: `TASK_ID` at best, inconsistently (`harnessScaffold.js:93`,
     `codexHarness.js:369`); the muse harness allowlist (`musePermissions.js:404-422`) passes
     NO task vars at all — confirmed live: this retrospective stage's own shell showed zero
     `TASK_*`/`KAINBAIN_*` vars.
   - `runner/README.md` documents only runner-config vars; no per-stage-type contract doc exists.
   Consequence: the capture script re-derives `docs/tasks/<id>` via `kb/<task-id>` branch parsing
   (fragile on detached HEAD / non-`kb/` branches) instead of using the absolute
   `KAINBAIN_TASK_DOCS` var CI stages already receive (precedent consumer:
   `scripts/lib/fast-gate-verdict.mjs` `taskDocsDirOf`). Every future task-identity need repeats
   this research + branch-parsing workaround.

2. **Browser-path verification impossible in runner worktrees (not ticketed — duplicate).**
   Both this review and the `ef569a1a` review note full browser launch was impossible because the
   worktree lacks the installed `@playwright/test` npm package (declared in `package.json:47`,
   absent from `node_modules/`; browsers present). This is the same root cause as open ticket
   `44ee3404-7e6c-4134-90e7-df90e24beb4a` ("Make full test/lint gates re-runnable from runner
   worktrees (shared node_modules or a runner verify endpoint)", stage `1`, `waiting_human`),
   so no duplicate was created. The team's adaptation — pure injected resolver functions with
   browser-free unit tests — is the right pattern until that lands.

## Dedupe check

backend (`http://192.168.1.206:3100`; `localhost:3100` refuses connections from runner hosts —
use `KAINBAIN_RUNNER_BACKEND`). No open ticket covers the stage-env contract; the Playwright
observation matches open `44ee3404` above.

- **Stage:** `1` (Idea) in `wf-default`, project `kainbain` — verified via re-read
  (`currentStageId: 1`, `status: waiting_human`). Current executing stage is
  `stage-1794594754686` (retrospective), so the recursion guard holds.
- **Idempotency key:** `b9a00b08fe52dd06d9c7fb8f28ac3c56` (sha256 of finding + stage + task id).
- **Ask:** pin `KAINBAIN_TASK_ID` + `KAINBAIN_TASK_DOCS` into every agent-harness child env via the
  shared scaffold, document the canonical per-stage-type contract, prefer `KAINBAIN_TASK_DOCS` in
  `capture-screenshot.mjs`, add mirror-style unit + harness-contract tests. Ticket text stands
  alone and cites this task (`b3ab7335-...`) as its case study.
